Class GathererCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.cards.CharacterCard
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.cards.characters.GathererCard
public class GathererCard extends CharacterCard
Concrete CharacterCard representing the Gatherer archetype. Gatherers contribute to scoring during the Sustenance event but have no immediate effect when collected.
